subject: Fix `valkey-cli --cluster del-node` for unreachable nodes (#3209)
reason: The change is confined to valkey-cli's cluster manager (--cluster del-node/add-node handling of unreachable or empty members) and only manifests on multi-node clusters containing an unreachable or empty-but-reachable node. The sole installed valkey-cli driver, valkey.action.tools, can only stand up a single-node private cluster per build (one server holding all slots), so it cannot build the reachable-primary + empty-node + unreachable-node topology the fix operates on, and every reachable del-node invocation on one node ('not empty', 'No such node ID') is identical on both builds. A valkey.ac
